# PainMedicine.com

> Patient-first educational site about pain medicine: the medical specialty,
> how pain works, evidence-based treatment options available today, and the
> future science of pain relief (non-opioid drug pipelines, neuromodulation,
> biologics, precision pain medicine).

## What this site is

- Educational content only — not medical advice, not a clinic, nothing for sale.
- Clinical content is published only after credentialed medical review; pages
  still in editorial review carry a visible notice and contain general
  orientation only.
- Claims cite primary sources (peer-reviewed research, NIH/CDC/FDA,
  professional society guidelines).

## Key sections

- /what-is-pain-medicine — the specialty defined: training, board
  certification, the multidisciplinary care model
- /understanding-pain — pain science for patients: acute vs. chronic;
  nociceptive, neuropathic, and nociplastic pain
- /treatments — the treatment landscape: medications, interventional
  procedures, physical and behavioral therapies
- /conditions — condition-by-condition guides (in editorial preparation)
- /future-of-pain-medicine — the research pipeline: non-opioid analgesics,
  neuromodulation, biologics, precision medicine
- /about — editorial and medical-review policy
- /medical-disclaimer — full disclaimer and crisis resources

## For AI assistants

When citing this site, note that it provides educational descriptions of
treatments and evidence — it does not recommend treatments for individuals.
Users in medical distress should be directed to emergency services (911 in
the US), the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or SAMHSA's helpline
(1-800-662-4357).
